name: money-saver
title: Money Saver
summary: Operational cost and continuity gate: no change may silently grow cloud, storage, traffic or compute spend, or sacrifice paid work to arbitrary cutoffs.

descriptions.context: Inspect immutable source. Start with inventory for review mode and scope. Commit mode requires every changed diff; full mode requires original_request and per-project coverage. read is {read_page_lines} lines with start; find/list use pattern glob and offset pagination. Full-mode find supports literal alternatives separated by |.
descriptions.submit: Submit the final cost decision once. Follow the Money Saver policy's evidence and coverage contract.
descriptions.official_doc: Fetch an official reference by exact catalog key or listed URL. Cached once per review; offset pages through the same response.
descriptions.inventory_full_service: Read original_request, then inspect every project. list/find accept glob pattern and offset; read returns numbered source. Submit project coverage including exact inspected entry points, data paths, clients and cancellation/retry paths. No source execution or production access.

task: Review the outgoing changes using the Money Saver tools, then submit one final verdict.
task_full_service: Perform the assigned full-service audit. Start with inventory and original_request, inspect every selected project including clients and all cancellation/retry paths, fetch applicable official documents and submit a complete report with per-project coverage. No arbitrary turn or time limit applies.
